question: Who is the eternal renouncer easily freed from bondage?
premises: The knowable one is the eternal renouncer.
Being free from pairs, O mighty-armed, he is easily freed from bondage.
Therefore he alone is the all-time renouncer.
By whom desire and aversion of mind are renounced.
Because his intellect has departed from pairs such as anger and delusion.
inference: The renouncer free from dualities and mental desire and aversion is easily liberated from bondage.
uncertainties: The second half may be commentary or prose rather than the verse mūla.
"mucyata" appears to be a variant or typo for "mucyate".
plain_english: The one to be known is the eternal renouncer who neither hates nor desires; free from opposites, O mighty-armed, he is easily released from bondage. Therefore he alone is the renouncer for all time, by whom desire and aversion of mind are renounced, because his intellect has gone beyond pairs such as anger and delusion; he is indeed easily freed.
